recognize_zh: 巴瑞特食道（可見杯狀細胞的腸化生腺體）的固有層被大量細胞質充滿嗜酸性球狀物的漿細胞（Mott cells／Russell bodies）撐開；漿細胞標記強陽性，kappa/lambda 雙色原位雜交呈混合表現，支持反應性而非單株性漿細胞增生。
features: Glandular mucosa with intestinal metaplasia (goblet cells) and lamina propria expanded by a cellular infiltrate
High power: sheets of plasma cells with abundant eosinophilic, glassy cytoplasm distended by Russell bodies, pushing nuclei eccentrically
IHC (panel C) highlights a dense cluster of plasma cells in the lamina propria
Dual kappa/lambda staining (panel D) shows admixed brown and red positive cells, indicating polytypic plasma cells
No destructive lymphoepithelial lesions or atypical lymphoid infiltrate evident
describe_en: Esophageal glandular mucosa with intestinal metaplasia shows the lamina propria expanded by an infiltrate of plasma cells. At high power, many plasma cells contain abundant eosinophilic globular cytoplasmic inclusions (Russell bodies), forming Mott cells with eccentric compressed nuclei. Immunohistochemistry highlights the plasma cell aggregate, and dual kappa/lambda staining shows a mixture of kappa- and lambda-expressing cells without light-chain restriction. Findings are consistent with reactive Mott cell (Russell body) plasmacytosis in Barrett esophagus, sometimes termed Russell body gastritis/esophagitis.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma shows a dense atypical B-cell infiltrate with lymphoepithelial lesions and light-chain-restricted plasma cells, unlike the polytypic plasma cells here.
Signet ring cells contain mucin vacuoles that indent the nucleus and are keratin positive, whereas Mott cells have eosinophilic immunoglobulin globules and are CD138 positive/keratin negative.
Plasmacytoma forms a mass of monotypic plasma cells, while this infiltrate is polytypic by kappa/lambda staining.
These contain granular or foamy cytoplasm without Russell bodies and are S100 or CD68 positive rather than plasma cell markers.
